messages.text: BL-1723 🎵 in progress — specs/features/BL-849-swarm-stamp-darwin-orphan-janitor-hotfix.feature scenario 03 row 2 is red on main (7 pass / 1 fail, coder note 002118): orphan_janitor_lib.bb's disposable-root-re accepts bl<number>- fixture roots only under Darwin's /var/folders/.../T/, never under Linux /tmp, so the Linux host's janitor is blind to ancillaries left under /tmp/bl<N>-* roots - the shape 852 fixture sites in the step handlers and tests create; the Linux branch accepts the same bl<number>- family
